subject: Save & Stabilize: proposal for Account Cascade (renewal escalation)
messages:
From: Ava Singh <ava@cascade.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal conversation — pricing pressure and SLA issues

Connor / Lauren,

Thanks for the partnership this year — Cascade has seen material lift from the inference improvements your team shipped, but we need to talk about the upcoming renewal (dec 1). Our finance team is under a hard cap for Q4 spend and the current renewal proposal puts us over budget by ~$180k. Separately, we've had two incidents in the last quarter where inference latency exceeded our SLO during peak windows; those have measurable customer impact.

We'd like to propose the following to make the renewal work:
- A 25% discount on list for the next 12 months OR a term reset to start a shorter 6-month renewal at a reduced rate (we're open to which is easier for you)
- A one-time credit to reimburse the outage impact (we estimate ~$25k)
- SLA addendum for 99.9% during peak hours (9am–9pm PT) with a commitment to a cadence of quarterly performance reviews

We have legal questions too — cc'd them. Can we schedule 30 minutes this week to walk an alternative package? I'm attaching a short cost summary and our usage trends.

Attachments: [Attachment: cascade_costs_q3.csv]

Appreciate any flexibility you can offer — otherwise we will likely evaluate alternatives at renewal.

Best,
Ava Singh
Director, Platform Engineering
Cascade.ai

--
(Forwarded) Previous notes attached for context

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Singh <ava@cascade.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — pricing pressure and SLA issues

Ava — thanks for the clear note and the call earlier today. Appreciate the context and the usage data; it's helpful.

Short summary of what the account team can preliminarily offer while I escalate for approvals:
- A temporary 15% off list on the renewal quote (12-month term) while we finalize paperwork
- A one-time operational credit equal to $20k to offset incident impact (applied at contract execution)
- An SLA addendum: 99.9% during 9am–9pm PT for the first 12 months of the renewal with an obligation to monitor and a joint quarterly review

I want to be transparent that 15% + $20k credit is outside of my standard quota authority, so I'm looping in Vivek and Marissa to confirm what we can commit to and whether we can inch up on the concession. If needed, I will escalate to exec signoff.

If that package addresses Cascade's finance constraints, please confirm and we'll draft an updated SOW and change order (we can fast-follow DocuSign). If you prefer a term-reset structure (6 months at a different rate), say so and we'll run the numbers.

Attaching a first-pass redlined SOW and a savings model for internal review.

Attachments: [Attachment: SOW_Cascade_Q4_draft.docx], [Attachment: redwood_savings_model_CASCADE.xlsx]

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0123

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-07T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal conversation — pricing pressure and SLA issues

Team — reviewed the usage and margin impact. I appreciate Connor's initial package but recommend we tighten the ask to balance retention risk vs. precedent. Thoughts below: 

Proposed concession (recommended):
- 12% off total ARR (instead of 15%)
- One-time credit of $30,000 (to cover customer incident impact and demonstrate good will)
- SLA addendum for 99.9% during 9am–9pm PT for the length of the renewed term (12 months)
- Require a 12-month commitment (no 6-month resets) and a clear operational playbook for mitigating latency spikes

Rationale: 12% keeps us closer to target OC margins, the $30k credit is a one-time cash accounting hit that is easier to approve than a deeper list discount long-term, and the 12-month term avoids churn risk and administrative churn. This also buys time for our Optimize team to run batching/quantization recommendations that should reduce recurrence of incidents.

Approvals needed: 
- Marissa: final legal/SLA language review and signoff for the addendum
- Jordan (ops/sales leadership): exec authority to go to 12% + $30k credit (this exceeds Connor's quota)

If we get a green light, Connor — update the SOW with the credit line item and Marissa will add the SLA clause. Please mark this as urgent — customer indicated they'll review alternatives if we can't move.

-Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

[Inline: Vivek attached a quick margin sensitivity sheet for internal use]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-09T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request — Cascade retention concessions (DEAL-8872)

Marissa / Jordan,

Requesting expedited exec approval to commit to the following retention package for Cascade.ai to close the renewal and avoid churn: 

Ask (final):
- 12% off list on the upcoming renewal (ARR reduction)
- One-time customer credit: $30,000 applied at contract execution
- SLA addendum: 99.9% availability during 9am–9pm PT for 12 months; Redwood to provide quarterly performance reviews and a remediation playbook as part of the SLA
- Term: 12 months (no shorter resets)

Why we should approve:
- Customer is strategic in the AI infra segment and has become a vocal reference for our latency improvements; losing them would pose GTM and competitive risk
- Finance impact: estimated NPV loss vs. list is acceptable given retention vs. new logo cost; Vivek's margin sensitivity attached shows acceptable thresholds
- Operational mitigation: Product and Optimize teams will deploy batching and targeted quantization recommendations post-signature which should materially reduce future incidents

If we cannot get signoff, Cascade has indicated they'll run a parallel procurement RFP and we risk a window where they evaluate alternatives. Connor has the customer on standby this week for signature if we can commit.

Requested outcome: Exec approval email confirming authority to offer the package above, or counter-proposal with explicit limits (max discount %, max credit $).

Attachments: [Attachment: Cascade_Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf], [Attachment: SOW_Cascade_Q4.xlsx]

Thanks for the quick attention — happy to join a 15-minute sync now if helpful.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0123
